gaps.sentence: He felt he was ___ for the work he did, so he asked for a raise (PAY).
gaps.hint: paid too little — he wants a raise (under-)
gaps.explanation: The prefix under- means too little: underpaid means paid less than deserved, which explains asking for a raise.
A bank manager is a person; 'management' is the activity and 'manage' is the verb.

gaps.sentence: He had a happy ___ in the countryside (CHILD).
gaps.hint: noun needed: the period of being a child (-hood)
gaps.explanation: The suffix -hood forms period-of-life nouns: childhood.

gaps.sentence: The ___ (DEEP) of the lake is still unknown.

gaps.explanation: After 'Her' a noun is needed: illness (-ness noun of 'ill').

gaps.sentence: This guidebook is really ___ for travellers (USE).
gaps.explanation: The suffix -ful means full of: useful. 'Useless' is the negative opposite.

gaps.sentence: The treaty will strengthen economic ___ between the two countries (COOPERATE).
gaps.explanation: An adjective is followed by a noun: cooperation (-tion noun).

gaps.sentence: He denied all knowledge of the ___ (APPEAR) of the documents.
gaps.explanation: The documents vanished, so the negative noun 'disappearance' is needed; 'appearance' means coming into view.
